summary.en:
- [[character:evernight]]'s Skill summons Evey, who has two Skills. When [[character:evernight]] has fewer than 16 "Memoria" stacks, Evey deals single-target DMG. At 16+ "Memoria" stacks, Evey detonates, dealing AoE DMG and increasing [[character:evernight]]'s SPD based on the number of "Memoria" stacks consumed.
- Evernight gains "Memoria" whenever she or Evey take an action, or whenever she loses HP.
- [[character:evernight]]'s Ultimate grants 2 stacks of "Darkest Riddle", increasing her "Memoria" generation. [[character:evernight]]'s loses 1 stack of "Darkest Riddle" whenever Evey detonates.
- [[character:evernight]]'s performance is heavily reliant on [[character:cyrene]] for her buffs and Sub-DPS contribution.

details.en:
- E1 increases the damage dealt by allied Memosprites when fewer enemies are present. A strong support Eidolon thanks to its unique damage multiplier.
- S1 [[light-cone:to-evernights-stars]] grants teamwide DEF ignore for Memosprites, increases her personal damage, and restores additional Energy whenever Evey detonates. A strong Light Cone option that both improves her personal damage, provides team utility, and supports her Ultimate rotation.
